description: The main window's cover (cover.rs): a page of the app over the server's page. It may drag the window, ask which server is open, load it again once it is reachable, step aside, or stay over a server whose app API this app doesn't speak; for the server here, start it, turn reach off, copy its details or send a report of them (with this computer's system, size, the web view's memory and the opening's time), read Tailscale's state (whether there is its app to open) or open Tailscale; for a server out of reach or the server here stopped, open the welcome window or another server of the app's list. Nothing of the server's page, the runners or this computer.
